description: Creates one new user label in an account. Use "Parent/Child" to nest it under an existing label. Gmail rejects a name that already exists, so check list_labels first. Nothing else changes: no email is moved, labeled or deleted. The change is written to the local audit log (see recent_changes).

account.description: Email address or label of the account (see list_accounts).

name.description: Label name, e.g. "Receipts" or "Clients/Acme" to nest it

name: create_label
